context: Do not begin until the authorization and worktree gates pass. Preserve unrelated changes, use temporary outputs for tests, fail closed on uncertainty, and stop on any data-loss or false-success signal.
description: Load the exact --config path, defer manager construction, reject missing or malformed files with nonzero status, and add subprocess coverage for valid, alternate, malformed, and missing configs.

preserves.behavior: Existing user files, existing result artifacts, backward compatibility, rollback evidence

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c "from pathlib import Path; import subprocess; import tempfile; p=Path(tempfile.mktemp(suffix=\".yaml\")); p.write_text(\"database: [unclosed\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\"); r=subprocess.run([\"uv\", \"run\", \"--\", \"benchbox\", \"validate\", \"--config\", str(p)], capture_output=True, text=True); p.unlink(missing_ok=True); assert r.returncode != 0; assert \"Configuration is valid\" not in r.stdout + r.stderr"

work_units.evidence: Commit 995a78050e: explicit --config validation loads the requested file in strict mode and fails closed. Focused public CLI/config tests: 26 passed. Full preflight: 28,381 passed, 19 skipped.
work_units.summary: Implement fail-closed config loading and subprocess acceptance tests
